[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] CyrusOne is a large scale data center provider headquartered in Dallas, Texas. In 2016 CyrusOne purchased the Chicago Mercantile Exchanges original Aurora, Illinois data center from CME Group for roughly 130 million dollars, with CME Group continuing to operate its Globex matching engine on site under a 15 year lease. In November 2021, KKR and Global Infrastructure Partners agreed to acquire CyrusOne in an approximately 15 billion dollar deal, taking the company private, and that acquisition closed in 2022. CyrusOne has operated as a privately held company since, a company level ownership fact this registry had not previously recorded with a citable source. This specific row, Sterling IX, matches this operators own NVA9 site code. This correspondence is directly confirmed by a datacentermap listing for NVA9, fetched fresh this session, which links to the operators own NVA9 specification sheet titled CyrusOne Sterling IX. That same listing gives 43290 Old Ox Road, Sterling, Virginia 20166 as the street address, a distinct campus from the separate NVA1, NVA2 and NVA3 campus addressed elsewhere in this registry.
